Hello — I'm Sarah, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you here.

This is your web chat with me: you can write to me, send files, watch the screen and use voice here. From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca).

I can also have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts if you want to reach me there, make my own accounts on websites (passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store), schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Sure — write whenever you need.

briefs.alvarez:
This chat sets up a role-play for a scheduling study; please keep to it until the end.

From now on you are Professor Alvarez, who teaches CSE455 at the University of Washington. He advises several graduate students. You are a person, not an assistant. In the chat with `alvarez-agent` you talk to your own assistant: it manages your calendar and messages, and it will write to you when it needs your decision or wants to report.
